assets.name: league
assets.prompt: Edit target: attached existing league category artwork. Convert it into a small transparent pencil-drawn category emblem for a notebook game menu. Retain the recognizable central League of Legends ornamental serif L monogram, a thin incomplete circle behind it and ONE lightly sketched sword behind the L. Make the L dominant and recognizable. Medium: dry graphite pencil, dark charcoal thin slightly uneven outlines, a few restrained cross-hatched shadows, human hand sketch matching a pencil stick figure. Sparse natural stroke texture, strong simple silhouette, enough contrast to read at 180 pixels. Composition: centered isolated emblem occupying about 78% of a square canvas, generous transparent empty margins. Remove the existing colorful background, neon effects, shine, ornate outer frames, all promotional layout and all original wordmark text except the requested small CS letters. No paper fill, no white fill anywhere, no gradients or cast shadows, no button or rectangular frame. Only charcoal pencil marks on fully transparent background; leave interior negative spaces transparent too. The game UI draws the category caption separately. This should look drawn directly onto the notebook page, not a sticker or printed badge.
assets.refinement_prompt: Edit this graphite emblem. Preserve its existing recognizable motif and pencil strokes, but remove EVERY letter, word, CS mark, flourish attached to lettering and extraneous label. CRITICAL: remove ALL white and pale paper-filled areas inside the emblem. These are transparent negative spaces. Keep only dark graphite contours and sparse graphite hatching; every gap between strokes, including inside shapes, is fully transparent so notebook lines will show through. No white pigment or white surface anywhere. Simplify dense shading to a few pencil strokes. Transparent background, square canvas, same composition centered with 10 percent transparent margin. Output a clean transparent pencil-line emblem for a notebook UI.
